review: Base data contains basic-ball only, no Octocat. Fonts retain separate notices. Only official easy set (25 maps) and putt course included. No add-on catalogue, remote fetch, service worker, account or telemetry. Original runtime source archive includes engine, data and build instructions; gl4es pinned by upstream build workflow. All runtime payloads copied unchanged; host adapter authored separately. Full upstream audio omitted from playback.
host_adaptations: Generated JS native add-on fetcher replaced at one checked anchor with no-network in-memory empty catalogue. All upstream snapshots remain unchanged.
Opaque-origin iframe receives WASM/data/course buffers from parent; no runtime network permissions. Bounded validated user file snapshots bridge to existing local save storage.

Native Scores directory and root preferences are bounded and validated; replay blobs over 60 KB are omitted. Native pointer capture is disabled so host controls remain reachable; mouse/touch motion remains in-frame.

gl4es_packaging.excluded: traces/ contains runtime captures not required for building; omitted because captured game assets are outside this license review
gl4es_packaging.retained: All other source, headers, build files and license entries with original content
